summary: Reproduced ZIP digest/CRC (2,372 entries, no duplicates), all 75 build entries, all 66 raw shards, report/mismatch hashes and counts. Recomputed 49 pins/source-set; verified 43 sources vs local+git-show and six generated CI assets. Amend C-ARTIFACT wording: GitHub artifact metadata binds run/head SHA but exposes no tree; tree is in captured CI/gate metadata and local commit evidence.
limitations: GitHub artifact metadata binds the run and head SHA, not a tree SHA
tree-to-head binding relies on captured commit/tree evidence; the published head object is absent locally
all-ten workflow status is read from captured ci.json/artifact-ready metadata; this review queried primary artifact metadata only
no build, tests, or repository mutation performed
